payload.artist_html: Attila Ősi1*, Edina Prondvai1, Richard Butler2, David B. Weishampel3
payload.description_html:
Cranial remains of Mochlodon vorosi n. sp. from the Upper Cretaceous Csehbánya Formation, Iharkút, western Hungary.

  • A, right quadrate (MTM V 2010.111.1) in cranial,
  • B, caudal,
  • C, lateral,
  • D, medial,
  • E, distal views;
  • F, left dentale (MTM V 2010.105.1) in lateral,
  • G, medial,
  • H, occlusal views;
  • I, left postorbital (MTM 2012.14.1) in dorsal,
  • J, ventral,
  • K, lateral views.

Anatomical abbreviations:

  • anf, articular surface for angular; cof, articular surface for coronoid; cop, coronoid process; ded, dorsal edg of the dentary; dep, depression; fo, foramen; gr, groove; jpr, jugal process; ltfm, margin of lateral temporal fenestra; orm, orbital rim; ptp, pterygoid process; qco, quadrate condyles; qh, quadrate head; qjs, articular surface for quadratojugal; sqpr, squamosal process; sqs, articular surface for squamosal; stfm, margin of supratemporal fenestra; surf, articular surface for surangular; sy, symphysis; to, tooth; 10th, 10th alveolus.
